headline: Result Update

highlights: (HUL) Important Data • The company reported 15% YoY growth in revenue to 18,071crs, the highest in the last 14 quarters.

Underlying Volume Growth remained strong at 7%, underpinned by disciplined execution and ongoing portfolio transformation. • Performance was broad-based across segments, with Home Care and Beauty & Wellbeing delivering strong double-digit USG driven by strong double-digit UVG.
Personal Care and Foods also saw a sequential step up, delivering 9% USG each. • EBITDA grew 8% YoY to ₹ 4,089crs.
High raw material costs and ongoing commodity inflation squeezed the EBITDA margin by 130 basis points year on year to 22.5% (within guided range), despite reduced ad spending.
valuation: Valuation & Outlook Concall highlights 16 November 2026 CMP*: ₹1,998/- Sector – FMCG Hindustan Unilever Ltd.
watch: The B&W segment remains a key growth driver from its accelerating investments, as company will also continue to focus on scaling up new categories within this segment.
HUL’s leadership in its key categories, wide distribution and recovering volumes leave it well placed to benefit as consumer demand improves.
